New conclusion is a non sequitur. The 16 signed commands discarded by ArduPilot are presented as support for the strict next sequence rule of the formal proofs. They were discarded under the published, looser rule (timestamp greater than the last, gaps allowed) because a retransmitted frame arrived after a newer one. A strict next sequence rule rejects every such late frame and also blocks on any gap, so the observation argues that the strict rule costs more availability on a lossy, retransmitting link, not that it is supported.
